review_candidates.description: With a company culture rooted in collaboration, expertise and innovation, we aim to promote progress and inspire our clients, employees, investors and communities to achieve their greatest potential. Our work is the catalyst that helps others achieve their goals. In short, We Enable Possibility℠. Arch is looking for a Software Engineer with experience in finance and various financial systems. Maintains standards, configurations, and scripts dealing with cloud-based and on-prem instances and services. Supports and provide servers / environments to the development teams to allow the easy creation/update/deletion of needed test environments. Supports and works with other engineers in the automation and set up of new servers, switches, firewalls, load balancers and operating systems in both on premise and cloud-based infrastructures for the execution of Infrastructure as Code. As part of Agile teams, completes complex software development work involving creative application of design, coding and debugging methods and techniques. Keeps Agile team and APM updated on product status. Reviews logs to support security processes; ensures the infrastructure and build pipeline is running optimally and automated and scheduled operations are successful. Plans, documents, implements, and oversees infrastructure upgrades and configuration changes. Recommends, purchases, and evaluates new technologies based on business, end-user, and technology requirements and expertise. Assists in the design of and participates in disaster recovery planning, testing, and response with a focus on system recoverability. Supports business units in the resolution of in-depth user questions and issues. Maintains a working knowledge of new technology and software engineering standards & practices. Collaborates with IT management to define and develop documentation & engineering artifact standards, guidelines, processes, and templates. Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate and Power BI), Finance/Accounting Knowledge, Workday, Accounting Software Support, Decision Focus, Snowflake (is a plus). Finance technology experience in a corporate environment Experience with General Ledger Accounting and Reporting systems (GL, AR, AP, Consolidations etc.) Understanding of APIs, integrations, and ERP systems (Microsoft Dynamics Great Plains, Workday) Experience with monitoring tools for infrastructure monitoring, reporting, and alerting processes. Demonstrated success in supporting development and infrastructure teams. Expertise in proactive management of production systems. Experienced in scalable, high-availability back end technologies Oracle and SQL Server Experience with Insurance / Reinsurance Systems and Data Experience in supporting 3rd Party hosted systems Desired Skills/Experience Convey technical concepts in a clear, understandable way Make decisions in a fast-paced, deadline-driven and rapidly changing environment Establish credibility, influence, and effective working relationships with peers and stakeholders Interact and partner at all levels across the organization Ability to be both strategic and tactical in day to day interactions Understanding of reporting tools like Power BI, OneStream Knowledge and experience with APIs and API development with microservices is required. Knowledge of AWS development and deployment is nice to have. Knowledge of Alteryx Analytics, Gtreasury, Concur and/or CoreIntegrator systems is nice to have Experience with ETL development, data manipulation and transformation. SSIS, SSRS a plus. Other helpful tool knowledge a plus including HTML, SAS, SQL and XML. Understanding of the project management software JIRA a plus. Solid design and implementation experience Education Required knowledge & skills would typically be acquired through a bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field plus 5+ years of related experience. review_candidates.title: Sales Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description BlueDez Engineered Solutions provides multidisciplinary engineering and design support to architectural firms, engineering consultants, and construction teams across the United States. The company supports structural, civil, mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP), and architectural projects , delivering coordinated solutions that comply with applicable U.S. codes and standards, with engineering work overseen by licensed Professional Engineers (PEs) in multiple states, as applicable. Role Description BlueDez Engineered Solutions is seeking a motivated and results-oriented Sales Engineer for a part-time, remote position. The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, developing client relationships, and promoting the company’s multidisciplinary engineering and design services to architectural firms, engineering consultants, and construction companies across the United States. The role involves understanding client requirements, presenting suitable solutions across structural, civil, MEP, and architectural disciplines, and coordinating with the engineering team to prepare proposals, preliminary estimates, and scopes of work. The Sales Engineer will also manage client inquiries, follow up on leads, maintain sales records, identify opportunities for repeat business, and support the transition from initial discussions to project initiation. The ideal candidate will combine strong sales and communication skills with an understanding of engineering and construction services. This position offers an opportunity to contribute directly to business development and company growth while working closely with a multidisciplinary engineering team. Qualifications Experience: 1–4 years of experience in sales, business development, or a related role. Sales Skills: Experience in lead generation, client follow-ups, and proposal support. Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with structural, civil, MEP, or architectural design services is preferred. Communication Skills: Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate professionally with U.S.-based clients. Client Relations: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build and maintain client relationships. Organization: Ability to manage multiple leads, follow-ups, and sales opportunities effectively. Remote Work: Ability to work independently in a part-time, remote position. Education: A background in engineering, construction management, business, or a related field is preferred. Industry Experience: Experience working with architectural, engineering, or construction firms is an advantage.
